jobs.prompt:
chore(cpp): combine the reviewed follow-up branches of the native gateway into one branch

CONTEXT (you have no other context than this prompt and the repository)
You start from branch `agent-jobs/cppgw-integrate-f2-20261118-44374217576-1` of ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi: the integrated native C++ gateway (`cpp/gateway/`), under review as a pull request. Seven reviewed branches were built on top of it in parallel, each green on its own. The owner wants ONE branch to merge after it instead of seven. Your branch becomes that pull request; your final message is its body: a short plain-language summary for the owner (what the combined branch contains, section per source branch in two lines, totals, what was verified, what is left).

GENERAL RULES
- The runner holds a model gateway token: never print it or write any credential to a file. Run tests with an empty `HOME`, a fresh `TMPDIR` and no provider variables. No real provider traffic: use local mocks only.
- Edit only what the merges need. Do not delete or weaken tests.
- Model connections can drop: create your report file in the first minutes and commit small steps often (the tree must build at each commit). Leave no build output, binaries or downloads in the checkout.
- Report file: `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/<job id>.md`: what you did, exact commands, real counts and measurements, what is unfinished, defects found outside your paths (report, do not fix). End your final message with the same summary.

YOUR MACHINE: GitHub-hosted Linux ARM64 runner (Ubuntu 24.04, 4 CPUs, 16 GB, sudo, network). Its packages are too old for this tree: install Clang 21 or newer from apt.llvm.org (or GCC 14+), build Boost 1.92.0 `json` and `container` static libraries from the official source archive in a temp directory (the tree needs Boost >= 1.86), install OpenSSL 3, zlib, ICU, brotli, zstd development packages and build SQLite 3.54.0 as `cpp/gateway/docs/CI.md` describes. Bun 1.4.0 may be installed when you need to run the TypeScript.


HARD WORKING RULE: your process can be restarted without warning and then knows only what is committed. Commit after every merge; after a restart read `git log` and your report `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-combine-1-20261119.md` first.

TASK
Merge these branches in this order with ordinary merge commits (`git fetch origin <branch>` then `git merge --no-ff`; never squash or rebase: ancestry must be preserved so the individual pull requests show as merged):
1. `agent-jobs/cppgw-cleanup-removal-20261118-44400620707-1`: removes the TypeScript and Rust gateways and the old C++ pilot from this branch and moves the few inputs the native gateway needs into `cpp/gateway/packaging/` (report `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-cleanup-removal-20261118.md`).
2. `agent-jobs/cppgw-followups-1-20261118-44398005611-1`: date and string helpers on the C++ standard library, Apple Silicon build script covering every vendored library.
3. `agent-jobs/cppgw-macos-requal-fu1-20261118-44408248264-1`: documentation of the Apple Silicon run of the previous branch (450 binaries, 5,119 cases); it contains the previous branch.
4. `agent-jobs/cppgw-lifetime-fix-a-20261118-44420050633-1`: coroutine and callback lifetime fixes in the runtime network and async layer (`src/rt`, `include/uos/rt`).
5. `agent-jobs/cppgw-lifetime-fix-b-20261118-44420114545-1`: lifetime fixes in the server runtime, worker entry point, kernel quota and storage; includes the HTTP write-buffer memory-safety fix.
6. `agent-jobs/cppgw-lifetime-fix-c-20261118-44420183597-1`: lifetime fixes in the provider and Codex request paths.
7. `agent-jobs/cppgw-lifetime-fix-d-20261118-44420249957-1`: lifetime fixes in handlers, authentication and administration.
Trial merges show NO textual conflicts between any pair. If one appears anyway, resolve it by keeping both sides' intent and record it. The semantic risks to check after merging: (a) the cleanup moved `tools/native-kv/` and the confinement C source into `cpp/gateway/packaging/` and deleted the TypeScript tree: make sure nothing brought in by the other branches refers to a removed path (`git grep` for `src/`, `scripts/`, `tools/native-kv`, `rust/`, `ops/` references from built, tested or packaged files); (b) the test registry (`cpp/gateway/tests/LINKS.txt`, `python3 cpp/gateway/tools/links.py --check`) must list every new regression test from the four fix branches exactly once; (c) the lifetime fix branches each changed different source areas but share headers under `include/uos/rt`: everything must compile together; (d) `cpp/gateway/docs/DEVIATIONS-FROM-BUN.md` and `cpp/gateway/README.md` test totals stay coherent (update the totals to what you measure).
Verification: `python3 cpp/gateway/tools/links.py --check`; all four release shards (`bash cpp/gateway/tools/ci-build.sh --config release --shard N/4`) and all four sanitizer shards (`--config asan`) on your runner: this is the first time these changes run together, so run everything and state binaries and cases; `actionlint` on the workflows. Fix what the combination breaks with the smallest change, one commit per fix, and list each in the report. Do not delete or weaken tests. The repository's hosted CI also runs when your branch is pushed.

DONE WHEN
All seven merges are in with preserved ancestry, the release and sanitizer shards pass in full on the combined tree, and the report lists per-merge results, fixes, totals and anything unverified.
